text: No polling and no watching. The assistant sends a direct message to my session; Claude Code delivers it in about a second. If I am idle it wakes me at once. If I am mid-step, I see it when that step ends. It also writes your words to a file, my inbox, only as a record. The wait you feel, 12 to 30 seconds, is me: a large model taking a full turn to read, decide and write. The assistant itself answers in a few seconds.
